_comment: Copy to workflow.config.json and keep only the agents you use. Any agent can fill any role, with one limit: the researcher must be a 'cli' or 'human' agent because it edits files and runs code. Placeholders in commands: {prompt}, {prompt_file}, {project_dir}, {framework_dir}. See docs/orchestration.md.

claude-code._comment: Runs inside the project folder; --add-dir lets it read the framework's docs and templates. 'session' tells the orchestrator how to continue a Claude Code conversation; when to continue is set in workflow.sessions.

codex._comment: OpenAI Codex CLI non-interactive mode (ChatGPT sign-in or API key).

codex-readonly-reviewer._comment: A reviewer in a read-only sandbox prints its critique; the orchestrator saves stdout. Verify that your Codex version prints only the final message on stdout.

gemini-cli._comment: Example only: check the non-interactive flags of your installed version.

claude-api._comment: Claude through the Anthropic SDK (pip install anthropic). Reviewer role only. Credentials from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or an `ant auth login` profile.

openai-api._comment: Any OpenAI chat-completions endpoint (pip install openai). Reviewer role only. Set model to an id your account offers.

local-model._comment: A local or self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server (for example Ollama or vLLM).

domain-expert._comment: A person fills the role; tasks arrive in the project inbox.

workflow._sessions_comment: researcher: 'run' = one conversation for the whole project (default), 'stage' = new one each stage, 'off' = new one every step; fresh_researcher_at lists stages where the researcher starts a new conversation. reviewer: 'stage' = new conversation each stage (default). A blind review's independent pass always starts a new conversation. Agents without a 'session' spec (for example API reviewers) always start fresh.
